title: From Notebook to Laboratory
summary: A single research moves from manual work to tier 1 and tier 2 stations.
description: Level 2: tier 1, 200 ticks, eight iron ingots and 1,000 computing work.
Level 3: tier 2, 300 ticks, eight gold ingots and 3,000 computing work.
The current-research panel changes shape as a later level becomes a station task. A low-tier database can only process the levels its tier allows.
